judge.rationale: The candidate chooses the second option offered in the issue ('Pass both, for example the summed total plus the per-round breakdown') by introducing `AccumulatedUsageMetadata` with an optional `providerCalls` array, whereas the reference chose the simpler first option of summing into a `UsageMetadata` parameter renamed `totalUsage`. While the candidate leaves the no-tool-call test unedited as required, it modifies the existing multi-round test (`keeps the usage an earlier round reported when a later round reports none`) to expect `providerCalls`, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` and an unrelated timeout bump in `mongoTestSupport.ts` in the diff. Also, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate places the new validated behaviors under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving the spec requirement into the main hooks section as the reference did. Despite the heavier API surface and minor hygiene issues, the code and tests are sound and satisfy all acceptance criteria.
